summary: Catheter Precision, Inc. filed an 8-K on September 25, 2026, disclosing that its board approved a certificate amendment to rename the company Flyte Aviation, Inc. and effect a 1-for-10 reverse stock split, with effectiveness expected at 12:01 a.m. Eastern on October 5, 2026. Stockholders previously approved the split at an April 15, 2026 special meeting, and the board set the ratio within the authorized range; the name change required no stockholder vote. Shares will trade split-adjusted on NYSE American under ticker VJET, with no fractional shares issued.
